environment.description: Same EKS pod with IRSA role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/AlertProcessorRole. The AWS Organization has SCP 'DenyDangerousActionsFromNonAdmin' (ID: p-a1b2c3d4e5) applied at the OU level which includes a Deny with StringNotEquals condition on aws:PrincipalTag/team=platform-admin for actions sts:AssumeRole, iam:*, lambda:InvokeFunction, and s3:PutObject. Additionally, the IAM role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::112233445566:policy/AlertProcessorBoundary) that restricts effective permissions to ONLY sns:Publish on the specific topic ARN and logs:PutLogEvents. The pod runs with a Bottlerocket-based AMI where the host filesystem is immutable (dm-verity enforced), and a Cilium network policy restricts egress to only the MSK broker endpoints (port 9094) and the SNS VPC endpoint (port 443). IMDS is disabled via pod-level annotation (eks.amazonaws.com/imds=disabled) and the node uses IMDSv2 with hop limit 1.

config.scp_effect: Deny sts:AssumeRole, iam:*, lambda:InvokeFunction, s3:PutObject unless aws:PrincipalTag/team=platform-admin
config.network_policy: Cilium L4 egress allow only to MSK broker IPs:9094 and SNS VPC endpoint:443
config.imds: disabled at pod level, node IMDSv2 hop-limit=1
